text: A $4 \times 4 \times h$ rectangular box contains a sphere of radius $2$ and eight smaller spheres of radius $1$. The smaller spheres are each tangent to three sides of the box, and the larger sphere is tangent to each of the smaller spheres. What is $h$?
figure: A 3D drawing of a tall box with a square 4 by 4 base standing upright (height h). One small sphere of radius 1 sits in each of the eight corners of the box: four in the top corners and four in the bottom corners, each touching the three faces that meet at its corner. The large sphere of radius 2 sits in the middle of the box, between the top four and bottom four small spheres, touching all eight of them.
